explication: parameterized-utils is a Haskell library for programming with type-indexed and parameterized types. A client defines indexed types, then uses runtime representatives to inspect or compare indices and existential wrappers or indexed containers to package values safely. Its other major capabilities are lifted typeclasses and traversals, associative maps and mutable hash tables, and length-indexed vectors. The README documents these APIs and examples; no source excerpts were provided, so edges show only relationships explicitly described there.
